- **Was:** the empty-sections line ignores the remembered 「显示空字段」 choice *on authored pages*.
- **Reading:** `EmptySectionsLine` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/EmptySectionsFold.tsx`, about lines 170–215) keeps its expanded state in local `useState(false)` and never reads `useRecordPagePreferences`. The default page and the authored `record:details` page both reach this one component from `DetailView.tsx` (about line 2149). So the line forgets the choice on **both** page kinds; #35161 only made authored pages draw it.
- **Fix, unchanged in kind:** the line follows the remembered `showEmptyFields` choice, as `DetailSection.tsx` (about lines 221–230) already does, and an expand is remembered. Both page kinds get a pin. The stale comment at `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (about lines 5560–5564) is corrected in the same PR.
- **Out of scope, named:** `EmptySectionsFold` (the whole-body fold) has the same gap. It becomes a follow-up if the PR confirms it.
